packageRules.description: One pull request for the whole Spring train. Boot, Framework, Security, Data and the starters only make sense together - the six different Boot 3.x baselines this workspace carried before the Boot 4 migration came from updating them one at a time.
Camunda stays manual. Client and cluster are only guaranteed compatible at equal versions, and a cluster upgrade in a customer project takes its time, so a library must never force one.
